status: Research standard; no production model selection or deployment
primaryQuestion: What has each FBS team earned from completed games in the current season, accounting for schedule difficulty?

allowed: Published, versioned rules chosen before evaluation
Documented correction of verified source errors
excluded: Human polls as inputs or optimization targets
Selecting parameters because familiar teams move up

achievementInputs: Individually identified opponents and their game network
historicalRole: Estimate general parameters using older seasons; historical team success supplies no current-season achievement credit.
predictiveRole: Keep opponent-adjusted margins and decayed historical team strength separate from achievement. Margin-cap experiments cannot alter this comparison.

candidates.benchmark: Current Colley achievement, prior 2 centered at 0.5
candidates.challenger: Exact leave-one-game-out SOR using mean FBS reference strength

historicalReplay.buckets: Distinct regular-season/postseason competition weeks, ordered by earliest kickoff
historicalReplay.cutoff: Before the earliest kickoff of the target week; only previously processed weeks and games with kickoff + 24 hours <= cutoff
historicalReplay.finalCheckpoint: After the last completed game kickoff + 24 hours; uses all eligible completed games
historicalReplay.population: Same complete source opponent population for both candidates; publish only source-designated FBS
historicalReplay.tiePolicy: Shared ranks within 1e-9; no-games teams unranked. Completed tied FBS results require an explicit additional policy and halt SOR evaluation.
knownLimits: Corrected retrospective data, not contemporaneously archived results
Season roster identities are retrospectively known
2021-2022 archive lacks postseason; do not label these complete final seasons
Previously inspected years cannot establish independent prospective superiority

requiredChecks: Validate identities, unique game IDs, scores, timestamps and membership
No target-week or later result enters a preweek snapshot
Team or conference renaming cannot change scores
Identical inputs and protocol reproduce the same numeric outputs
Removing a game analytically agrees with a full refit
With game probabilities fixed, a higher win total improves SOR
Report early-season sample sizes and disconnected FBS components
Keep code, published snapshots, frontend and service configuration unchanged
diagnostics: Teams with fewer than four completed games
diagnosticInterpretation: No diagnostic is an automatic winner-selection score. Agreement, low volatility and next-game accuracy do not alone establish earned achievement.
promotionRequirements: Resolve or disclose material data-coverage issues
Explain consequential disagreements through game evidence
Validate probability mapping in the context where it is used
Freeze the challenger before collecting genuinely future evidence
Publish a review of benefits, tradeoffs and uncertainty before any replacement
costAndOperations: Offline stored data only. No CFBD calls, paid services, deployment, or new scheduled job required by this research.
